component.name: rootChat
component.summary: Private, offline-first local AI desktop assistant powered by Ollama

description.p: rootChat is a private, modern desktop AI assistant for Linux powered exclusively by local Ollama models. Designed with an offline-first philosophy, rootChat ensures your prompts, documents, memories, and chat history never leave your local workstation.

ul.li: 100% Local and Offline: Zero telemetry, zero external cloud dependencies, complete privacy.
Local Document Knowledge Base (RAG): Ingest PDFs, code files, DOCX, and plain text notes with semantic vector retrieval.
Persistent Long-Term Memory: Remembers user preferences and personal facts with dedicated toggle switches.
In-App Model Manager: Search, pull, inspect, and delete Ollama models with real-time transfer speeds.
Quick-Query Mini-Chat: Spotlight-style floating HUD accessible anywhere via hotkey.
Customizable Personas: Tailored prompts for software engineering, Linux system administration, SQL, and technical writing.
Modern Dark and Light Themes: Clean typography, card-based settings, and FreeDesktop system tray integration.

description.p: Version 0.7.1 introduces top-bar memory toggles, per-conversation document knowledge base scoping, and a comprehensive settings audit.

ul.li: Dedicated top-bar selector for persistent memory with quick access manager
Dedicated top-bar selector for document knowledge base (off, all documents, or selected documents)
Settings expansion: default model selection, persona preset, temperature slider, context limit, and memory limit
Database maintenance tools: SQLite VACUUM defragmentation and chat clearing
Light and dark theme dropdown contrast and layout fixes
